rejectedCoverage.limitation: Projected-cell occupancy and ROI bbox intersections are test-only geometry proxies. ROI entries without worldBBoxEstimate cannot be assigned chunk IDs; profile handles are not tied to chunks by this mapping. No semantic or AutoCAD coverage is implied.

limitations: The 20x20 projected cells are compiled-geometry proxies, not pixel or semantic coverage.
ROI mapping uses provisional worldBBoxEstimate values only. ROI-05 through ROI-10 lack worldBBoxEstimate and valid chunk-bound source handles, so their rejected-chunk membership is unmeasured.
ROI-02 bbox intersects all 284 visible Model chunks and is not selective. ROI memberships overlap; per-ROI rejected counts must not be summed.
